tests.title: Associative memory and correction probe
tests.claim: The S3 synthetic probe retains all 50 sequentially added rules and moves the correction target to rank zero.

tests.how_we_got_it: Run the shipped check on an Intel i5-8365U laptop, 2026-10-17; output in results/2026-10-17-quick.log.
tests.use_in_your_work: Use the runnable checks to assess changes while keeping model/data prerequisites explicit.
tests.honest_limits: Seeded synthetic symbols only; finite capacity and nonzero interference remain.

tests.title: Local splining probe
tests.claim: S4 rechecks unchanged base accuracy, grows 24 nodes over 256 (9.38%), and scores 0.96 on its negative-only held-out novel slice.
tests.what_it_means: S4 rechecks unchanged base accuracy, grows 24 nodes over 256 (9.38%), and scores 0.96 on its negative-only held-out novel slice. The novel-task test indices 200:300 contain only negatives; the before score uses all-zero labels instead of Y_novel. This does not establish novel-fault detection or a valid before/after comparison.

tests.title: Splining negative is explicit
tests.claim: Historical S4 records 1.0 before and 0.96 after pruning, but the before score uses all-zero labels and the held-out slice contains only negatives.
tests.verify:
python3 -B -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path
d=json.load(open("s4/results/s4_spline_summary.json"))
s=Path("s4/spline_probe.py").read_text()
assert d["novel_fault_acc_before"]==1.0 and d["novel_fault_acc_pruned_frozen"]==0.96
assert "np.zeros(300, dtype=int))" in s
assert "for i in range(150):" in s and "np.arange(200, 300)" in s
print("PASS: historical scores retained; all-zero baseline labels and negative-only held-out slice disclosed")'
tests.what_it_means: Historical S4 records 1.0 before and 0.96 after pruning, but the before score uses all-zero labels and the held-out slice contains only negatives.
tests.how_we_got_it: Read the aggregate historical result named in evidence; no original training inputs or query text are included.
tests.use_in_your_work: Use the runnable checks to assess changes while keeping model/data prerequisites explicit.
tests.honest_limits: These scores do not establish a solved novel task, an improvement, or balanced fault detection.
